extension-definition--ef765651-680c-498d.title: Incident Core Extension
extension-definition--ef765651-680c-498d.description: A core extension of the Incident object to allow core details of the Incident to be shared while tracking major details tied to the incident's timeline.  Multiple Incidents can be tied together via relationships if a higher degree of fidelity is needed across phases.

extension_type.description: Defined by STIX 2.1 extension definition rules from 'extension-type-enum'.

scores.description: A list of scores from various automated or manual mechanisms along with optional descriptions

name.description: The name of the score.  This is normally a system or process name or some combination of these such as [Tool Name] Automated Exposure Score

description.description: An optional description about how this score was arrived at for systems that provide these

determination.description: If the incident has been confirmed or is suspected.  If it is determined to be benign it is considered a false-positive.

impact_refs.description: A list of the impacts of the incident

investigation_status.description: The current status of the incident investigation. See incident-investigation-ov
investigation_status.$comment: An Incident should be marked as New until some action is taken

incident_types.description: This property uses an Open Vocabulary that specifies the type of incident that occurred, if applicable.  This is an open vocabulary and values SHOULD come from the incident-type-ov vocabulary.

detection_methods.description: A list of strings containing what was used to detect the activity, ex. commercial tool names, techniques associated with proprietary solutions, human review, external sources, or other methods. See detection-methods-ov

criticality.description: How important this incident is to operations on a scale of 0 to 100.

Recoverability.description: The scope of impact required to recover from an incident
Recoverability.$comment: This is a closed vocabulary (enumeration): non-applicable is an addition to what is found on https://us-cert.cisa.gov/incident-notification-guidelines for Incident reports that do not have associated recover costs.  For example a phishing email that was detected successfully.

extension-definition--dff17fb3-edcb-4f99.description: This marking extension was created to represent Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) markings

extension_type.description: Defined by STIX 2.1 extension definition rules from 'extension-type-enum'.

designator_ref.description: A reference to the identity object representing the designator’s agency.

categories.description: The CUI Category or Subcategory Markings. Must come from https://www.archives.gov/cui/registry/category-marking-list

disseminations.description: The CUI Limited Dissemination Control Markings. Must come from https://www.archives.gov/cui/registry/limited-dissemination

supplemental_administrative.description: Supplemental administrative markings used to inform recipients of the non-final status of documents.

extension_type.description: Defined by STIX 2.1 extension definition rules from 'extension-type-enum'.

is_safe.description: Indicates whether the artifact is safe, i.e., can be opened or processed without risking harm or infection. The default value is false.

extension-definition--7cc33dd6-f6a1-489b.title: Impact
extension-definition--7cc33dd6-f6a1-489b.description: An extension for tracking the impact of incidents.

criticality.description: The criticality of this particular impact

description.description: An optional narrative that further describes this impact

impacted_entity_counts.description: A dictionary of entities that were impacted by the incident where the key is the entity type and the value is the number of entities of that type which were impacted.  In most cases these should be understood to be estimates.

^[a-z\\-]+.description: Key names MUST be lower case and separated by dashes.  Common values include 'individuals', 'organizations', 'business-units', 'facilities', 'information-systems'

start_time.description: The date the activity was first recorded.  If this is not present it is assumed to be unknown.

start_time_fidelity.description: The maximum degree of fidelity provided by the start_time.  When set to 'month' for example the timestamp 2021-02-01T04:00:00Z should only be read to be accurate to Februrary 2021 not a specific day within the month.

end_time.description: The date the activity was last recorded.  If this is not present it is assumed to be unknown.

end_time_fidelity.description: The maximum degree of fidelity provided by the end_time.  When set to 'hour' for example the timestamp 2021-02-01T04:00:00Z should only be read to be accurate to Februrary 1st 2021 between 04:00:00Z (inclusive) and 05:00:00Z (exclusive).

impact_category.description: The category of impact this applies to.  This MUST match a named extension within this object.

impacted_refs.description: A list of all impacted entities or infrastructure. This can relate directly to Infrastructure, SCOs, and other SDOs.

sub_impact_refs.description: The impact objects to that are part of this impact.

recoverability.description: The scope of impact required to recover from an incident
recoverability.$comment: This is a closed vocabulary: non-applicable is an addition to what is found on https://us-cert.cisa.gov/incident-notification-guidelines for Incident reports that do not have associated recover costs.  For example a phishing email that was detected successfully.

extensions.$comment: re-consider min_properties: 2 if undetermined is removed

information_type.description: The type of data that had its confidentiality compromised. See information-type-ov

record_count.description: The number of records of this type that were compromised

record_size.description: The amount of data that was compromised in bytes

information_type.description: The type of information that had its integrity compromised.  This can include control systems and other processes that can result in virtual or physical impacts.

alteration.description: The type of information that had its integrity compromised.  This can include control systems and other processes that can result in virtual or physical impacts.

record_count.description: The number of records of this type that were compromised

record_size.description: The amount of data that was compromised in bytes

currency.description: The currency that amount_min and amount_max are measured in

currency_actual.description: The currency that the impact actually used.  For ransom demands this should be the currency of the demand.

conversion_time.description: When the conversion rate between the actual currency and the amount currency was queried

max_amount.description: The lower bound estimate using the currency listed for the economic damage caused by this impact

min_amount.description: The lower bound estimate using the currency listed for the economic damage caused by this impact

dependentRequired.$comment: 'not currency_actual implies not conversion_rate' not specified here, but is in the spec

asset_type.description: The type of asset that was affected by this impact. See asset-type-ov

traceability_impact.description: The level of forensic or other traces left by the incident in order to enable auditing and accountability

type.title: type
type.description: The type property identifies the type of STIX Object (SDO, Relationship Object, etc). The value of the type field MUST be one of the types defined by a STIX Object (e.g., indicator).

spec_version.description: The version of the STIX specification used to represent this object.

id.description: The id property universally and uniquely identifies this object.

created_by_ref.description: The ID of the Source object that describes who created this object.

labels.description: The labels property specifies a set of terms used to describe this object.

created.description: The created property represents the time at which the first version of this object was created. The timstamp value MUST be precise to the nearest millisecond.

modified.description: The modified property represents the time that this particular version of the object was modified. The timstamp value MUST be precise to the nearest millisecond.

revoked.description: The revoked property indicates whether the object has been revoked.

confidence.description: Identifies the confidence that the creator has in the correctness of their data.

lang.description: Identifies the language of the text content in this object.

external_references.description: A list of external references which refers to non-STIX information.

object_marking_refs.description: The list of marking-definition objects to be applied to this object.

granular_markings.description: The set of granular markings that apply to this object.

extension-definition--66e2492a-bbd3-4be6.title: Identity Contact Information
extension-definition--66e2492a-bbd3-4be6.description: This extension allows contact information to be included in identities in a manner that allows them to be machine parsable.

extension_type.description: Defined by STIX 2.1 extension definition rules from 'extension-type-enum'.

contact_numbers.description: A list of contact number objects that contain the phone and fax numbers.

contact_number.description: The contact number.  Typically a phone number.

classified.description: Can be used to reach the individual on a classified phone.

contact_number_type.description: The type of number this is used for.  This SHOULD be drawn from contact-number-ov.

description.description: An additional description for the phone number and its purpose

email_addresses.description: A list of contact number objects that contain the phone and fax numbers.

email_address_ref.description: A reference to the email address itself

classified.description: Can be used to reach the individual on a classified network.

digital_contact_type.description: The type of email that address is used for.  This SHOULD be drawn from digital-contact-ov.

description.description: An additional description for the email and its purpose

social_media_accounts.description: A list of contact number objects that contain the phone and fax numbers.

user_account_ref.description: A reference to the social media account itself

classified.description: Can be used to reach the individual on a classified network.

digital_contact_type.description: The type of social media account that relates to.  This SHOULD be drawn from digital-contact-ov.

description.description: An additional description for the social media account and its purpose

first_name.description: The first name of an individual

last_name.description: The last name of an individual

middle_name.description: The middle name of an individual

prefix.description: A prefix or title for an individual such as 'Mr' or 'Ms'

suffix.description: A suffix for the individual such as 'PhD'

websites.description: A list of websites associated with the identity.

extension-definition--60a3c5c5-0d10-413e.description: This marking extension was created to apply TLP2.0 data markings

type.description: The type of this object, which MUST be the literal `marking-definition`.

spec_version.description: The version of the STIX specification used to represent this object.

created_by_ref.description: The created_by_ref property specifies the ID of the identity object that describes the entity that created this Marking Definition.

created.description: The created property represents the time at which the first version of this Marking Definition object was created.

external_references.description: A list of external references which refers to non-STIX information.

object_marking_refs.description: The object_marking_refs property specifies a list of IDs of marking-definition objects that apply to this Marking Definition.

granular_markings.description: The granular_markings property specifies a list of granular markings applied to this object.

tlp_clear.description: The marking-definition object representing Traffic Light Protocol (TLP) Clear.

extension_type.description: Defined by STIX 2.1 extension definition rules from 'extension-type-enum'.

extension-definition--4ca6de00-5b0d-45ef.title: Event
extension-definition--4ca6de00-5b0d-45ef.description: An extension for recording events in STIX.

state_change_type.description: How this activity influenced the change in state

description.description: A description of the activity that occurred.

status.description: The outcome of a particular attacker activity

start_time.description: The date the activity was first recorded.  If this is not present it is assumed to be unknown.

start_time_fidelity.description: The maximum degree of fidelity provided by the start_time.  When set to 'month' for example the timestamp 2021-02-01T04:00:00Z should only be read to be accurate to Februrary 2021 not a specific day within the month.

end_time.description: The date the activity was last recorded.  If this is not present it is assumed to be unknown.

end_time_fidelity.description: The maximum degree of fidelity provided by the end_time.  When set to 'hour' for example the timestamp 2021-02-01T04:00:00Z should only be read to be accurate to Februrary 1st 2021 between 04:00:00Z (inclusive) and 05:00:00Z (exclusive).

extension-definition--3a65884d-005a-4290.description: This marking extension was created to apply the SD-EDH Cyber Profile to ISA shared documents (ACS)

extension-definition--2074a052-8be4-4932.title: Task
extension-definition--2074a052-8be4-4932.description: An extension for recording tasks in STIX.

affected_entity_counts.description: A dictionary of entities that were impacted by the incident where the key is the entity type and the value is the number of entities of that type which were impacted.  In most cases these should be understood to be estimates.

^[a-z\\-]+.description: Key names MUST be lower case and separated by dashes.  Common values include 'individuals', 'organizations', 'business-units', 'facilities', 'information-systems'

state_change_type.description: How this activity influenced the change in state

description.description: A description of the activity that occurred.

due_date.description: The date and time the task is/was due to be completed. The value of due_date MAY be unrelated to the values of start_time and end_time, i.e., there is no requirement that a due_date be between those values.

items.description: A general type for the timestamp for higher level rollup. See task-type-ov

outcome.description: The outcome of a particular attacker activity

start_time.description: The date the activity was first recorded.  If this is not present it is assumed to be unknown.

start_time_fidelity.description: The maximum degree of fidelity provided by the start_time.  When set to 'month' for example the timestamp 2021-02-01T04:00:00Z should only be read to be accurate to Februrary 2021 not a specific day within the month.

end_time.description: The date the activity was last recorded.  If this is not present it is assumed to be unknown.

end_time_fidelity.description: The maximum degree of fidelity provided by the end_time.  When set to 'hour' for example the timestamp 2021-02-01T04:00:00Z should only be read to be accurate to Februrary 1st 2021 between 04:00:00Z (inclusive) and 05:00:00Z (exclusive).

error.description: Details about any failures or deviations that occurred in the task.

priority.description: How important this task is on a scale of 0 to 100.
